title: Timber Raking Shore Frame
description: One original static wooden raking-shore frame appearance for a ruined-building visual. The diagonal has a full horizontal cut heel seated on the sole and a full vertical cut head seated against the upright. Two pairs of thick fixed dark cheek limiter plates connect the lower and upper junctions through opposed finite exterior face seats; no penetrating geometry is counted as support. Seven individually editable closed connected solids and four constant opaque untextured PBR materials, including separate timber end-grain color faces. One prop and zero scenes. No wall or wall fragment is included; the complete asset boundary remains visible and independent. Newly authored numeric geometry, not an old easel, tripod, scaffold, rack or ladder renamed. Native Z up, front -Y, entire sole at ground. Coordinates in metres are game-space only.
